

## make bucket
- aws s3 mb s3://prefixes-sid-test-001

# create folder 
- aws s3api put-object --bucket="prefixes-sid-test-001" --key="hello/"
created a folder since no body 


## create many folders  - max folder size is 1024 byte
- aws s3api put-object --bucket="prefixes-sid-test-001" --key=""



# another one 
- aws s3api put-object --bucket="prefixes-sid-test-001" --key="" --body="hello.txt"



we can have many prefixes 
## to check the folder name and all 
aws s3api list-objects --bucket prefixes-sid-test-001
